use default

circle_sort_pass[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](
    values: LIST[T], lo: int, hi: int
) -> bool is
    if lo == hi then
        return false
    fi

    let low mut = lo
    let high mut = hi
    let swapped mut = false

    while low < high do
        if values[low] > values[high] then
            (values[low], values[high]) = (values[high], values[low])

            swapped = true
        fi

        low = low + 1
        high = high - 1
    od

    if low == high /\ values[low] > values[high + 1] then
        (values[low], values[high + 1]) = (values[high + 1], values[low])

        swapped = true
    fi

    let mid = (hi - lo) / 2

    let left_swapped = circle_sort_pass(values, lo, lo + mid)
    let right_swapped = circle_sort_pass(
        values, lo + mid + 1, hi
    )

    swapped \/ left_swapped \/ right_swapped

    swapped
si

circle_sort[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: LIST[T]) is
    while circle_sort_pass(values, 0, values.count - 1) do
    od
si

let numbers = LIST([6, 7, 8, 9, 2, 5, 3, 4, 1])

write_line(numbers |> join(", "))

circle_sort(numbers)

write_line(numbers |> join(", "))
